title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono move to 215 Lovell Avenue, Mill Valley | 1972
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono moved into 215 Lovell Avenue in Mill Valley, California, on 28 June 1972.

They had been staying in Ojai since early June, and in the final week moved to the Miyako Hotel in San Francisco. Shortly afterwards they decided to rent a house instead.

215 Lovell Avenue belonged to the Davis family, who had mutual acquaintances with Lennon and Ono. The family was travelling to Mexico for a month, and let it be known that the house was available. They viewed the property on 23 June, and moved in on this day. They remained at the property until early August 1972.
